fields.label: Share the antenna tuner
fields.help: Offers the TV's antenna tuner on the home network as an HDHomeRun, so Plex's DVR can list its channels, watch and record. One stream at a time, and the TV's own Live TV always comes first. In Plex, add the device by the TV's address and port 5004. Off: nothing listens and the tuner is left alone.
